summary: A dated implementation window lets payroll choose which check will first use a new tax table.
realLife: IRS released the 2018 tables in January and asked payroll providers to put them into use by mid-February; an industry association told GAO that interval was sufficient.
inGame: needs: a dated table release and an implementation deadline span multiple pay runs.
gates: A dated table release and an implementation deadline span multiple pay runs.

turns.what: The next run uses the revised table.
turns.writesBack: The office can name the first affected pay date.

turns.what: The old table runs once more.
turns.pulledBy: Testing finishes after cutoff but within the window.
turns.writesBack: The worker's comparison moves to the following stub.
